card.summary: 300 GB per file, unlimited number of files, no account required ('1ファイル300Gまで、個数無制限')

free_tier.stated: 300 GB per file, unlimited number of files, no account required ('1ファイル300Gまで、個数無制限')

retention.stated: 300 GB/file; retention selectable 3/5/7/14/30/60/100 days (default 5); 2 GB/day download per file per IP; optional 4-char download key and email notification; files expire hard after retention, no inactivity reset

egress.terms: free direct download via /download.php?file=<id>; no metering page exists, no bandwidth cap published; per-IP daily cap = 2 GB per file (5 downloads/day of the same file)

record.tooling: no rclone backend; plain multipart POST to https://<nn>.gigafile.nu/upload_chunk.php (id, name, chunk, chunks, lifetime, file); chunk_size=100mb, max_size=300gb are published as JS vars in the page source; own client is ~40 lines of python/curl
record.chaining: Quota is per record, not per account. 10 TiB = 35 uploads of 300 GB, 20 TiB = ~70; no account, no identity, so nothing to register and nothing to shard around. Only the 100-day retention forces a re-upload cycle.
record.limits_note: 300 GB/file; retention selectable 3/5/7/14/30/60/100 days (default 5); 2 GB/day download per file per IP; optional 4-char download key and email notification; files expire hard after retention, no inactivity reset
record.reliability_note: Download endpoint only serves when called with the referer/cookie chain from the file page (a bare GET returns an 'open the proper download screen' interstitial); datacenter IPs are ad-walled but the byte path itself worked
record.confidence_note: The per-object cap and the retention band are stated on the page as read on 2026-10-21. Was reported, now documented.

evidence.proved: '1ファイル300Gまで、個数無制限' (up to 300G per file, unlimited count), retention 3–100 days
